canonical_title: Big Tech uses residual value guarantees to finance AI infrastructure
aliases: Big Tech $300bn AI exposure off balance sheets
treatment: Repeat only for new disclosed guarantee amounts, named transactions, rating/accounting changes, defaults, or material financing-policy changes.
known_facts: Financial Times reported that residual value guarantees are increasingly being used to support AI infrastructure financing while limiting balance-sheet recognition.
The report identified roughly $300 billion of AI-related exposure supported by these structures and described use by companies including Meta, Nvidia and Broadcom.

The structures shift financing to special-purpose vehicles while technology companies provide minimum-value or related guarantees, creating contingent exposure that rating agencies may still consider.
reinclude_only_if: A company discloses a new material guarantee or transaction.
A rating agency, regulator or accounting authority changes treatment of these structures.
A guarantee is triggered, impaired or materially repriced.
New primary documentation materially changes the estimated exposure.
notes: Selected as the only strong post-midday hard delta in the 2026-09-20 Night Lite window.
